items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Sammy Cahn has, inadvertently, of course, written, or used the same title that he had used for another song, with which, you know, that he had collaborated with Nicholas Bronsky on.

ctx.x: And when the first record came out in the album, it listed as composer Nicholas Bronsky, Nicholas Bronsky and Sammy Cahn -- and when I saw this, I got in touch immediately with the studio, and wanted to know what had happened here. And I was told that they didn't really know, but that they would look into it.
Well, they got back to me, and what they discovered
